description: This file defines API endpoints related to license management in the Mattermost server, including functions for initializing routes, handling license addition, removal, retrieval, and load metrics.

methods.name: InitLicense
methods.description: Initializes license-related API routes for handling trial licenses, license management, and load metrics.

methods.name: getClientLicense
methods.description: Handles retrieval of client license information, with support for different formats and permission checks.

methods.name: addLicense
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving a new license, including validation and license restrictions.

methods.name: requestTrialLicense
methods.description: Processes requests for starting a new trial license, with permission and license manager checks.

methods.name: getLicenseLoadMetric
methods.description: Calculates and returns a load metric based on active users and license limits.
